_doc: Revert-verify mutants for issue #4513 (branch fix/4513-updateproperty-empty-value) — `createUpdatePropertyService` (service_call `updateProperty`, the THIRD writer of a frontmatter key) refuses a value that IS the empty string. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). ⛔ The SUBJECT lives in `packages/services/src`, the AXES in `packages/cli/tests` — on purpose: CI builds `packages/services` and never jest-runs it (and its one suite does not even execute on origin/main@474e9dd5, `TS2339 YAML11_SCHEMA`), while `packages/cli/jest.config.js` is run whole by the required `test-coverage-cli` and maps `@kitelev/exocortex-services` to the package SOURCE, so the mutated copy is what the axes exercise. The harness runs the new axes TOGETHER with the two pre-existing cli suites that import the same package, so a guard that was too broad surfaces as a RED CONTROL instead of passing unnoticed.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/services/src/grounding-service-factories.ts

M1_empty_value_guard_removed._note: #4513 primary item. Neutralises the refusal on a value that IS the empty string, restoring the junk write (`prop: ""` that looks like a cleared property). The mutation is TYPE-PRESERVING (same `value === <string literal>` shape, a sentinel that can never arrive) rather than `if (false)`, so a compile failure cannot be mistaken for a vacuous axis (ITRV §A36/§A97). Predicted V1 V2 — they redden together BY CONSTRUCTION: V1 pins that the refusal is TOTAL (nothing written) and V2 that the message is diagnosable; one guard carries both. V4 stays green and is the LOAD-BEARING control for the opposite direction — it proves the refusal keys on the empty string and not on whitespace. V3/V5/V6 stay green: they restate the pre-existing contract, which this mutant does not touch.

M2_guard_widened_to_trim._note: The TOO-BROAD half of the same guard: widening the strict `=== ""` into a trim() test — the shape that symmetry-with-the-siblings suggests and that req 501cdf2c's measurement forbids (0 carriers of `key: ""` but 15 of `key: " "` across 34 327 files / 331 263 keys, 2026-08-23: exo__PrintedLiteral_literal ×9, exo__DisplayNameSpec_separator ×6 — both free-text scalars reachable through this factory). Predicted V4 ALONE: the refusal axes V1/V2 pass either way (an empty string trims to itself), so only the whitespace control notices. That asymmetry is the point — it shows V4 is load-bearing and not decoration. ⛤ Unlike the `property_set` twin in #4511 (whose M3 was first vacuous on a QUOTED whitespace fixture), this predicate reads `userInput.value` DIRECTLY — no YAML scalar decoding sits between the form field and the guard — so V4's fixture is a raw one-character space and the widened predicate sees it.
